pages.title: Tatami and Tatami Mats
pages.text: Tatami mats are made for Japanese-style rooms. Placing one normally lays down a connected pair, which keeps the floor neater; with only one in hand, or no room in front of you, a single square mat goes down instead. Breaking a pair separates it again and each half gives a mat back, and the full-height tatami block pairs the same way.

pages.title: Cabinets
pages.text: Two cabinets of twenty-seven slots each, one with drawers and one with two doors. Right-click to open the storage; sneak-right-click only swings the drawer or the door open and shut without opening the interface at all. Both count as storage when a room is being measured for a home.

pages.title: Cartons, Crates and Books
pages.text: $(bold)Cartons$() They come in three colors.$(br2)$(bold)Crates$() A purely decorative block.$(br2)$(bold)Books$() A pile has three sizes you can cycle through by right-clicking it. Broken piles and stacks only drop their original crafting materials.
